title: Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy

strategy.summary: Send the ball to the top until the right gate is open, A and B are complete, and base bonus is 15,000, protect the 30,000 end-of-ball bonus, then repeat the safer top route or shoot the left drop bank from the lower-right flipper.

steps.text: On the plunge, read the three top-lane lamps.
When the center lane is lit, guide the ball through it.
modeNotes: Gate: Roll through the lit center top lane to open the gate beside the right outlane. A later right-outlane ball returns to the right inlane.

steps.text: When an outer top lane is lit, collect it for three bonus advances.
Return the ball to the top from either lower flipper.
modeNotes: Return-to-top lanes: Shoot the left lane from the lower right flipper. Shoot the right lane from the lower left flipper.

steps.text: Collect the left top lane for A and the right top lane for B.
modeNotes: Double Bonus: A plus B changes the end-of-ball bonus from 1x to 2x for this ball.

steps.text: Continue the top route until base bonus reaches 15,000. Protect the prepared 30,000 collect.
If the top route stays safe, continue it for lane, bumper, and rollover points.
If the top route becomes unsafe, shoot the left drop bank from the lower right flipper. Do not use an upper flipper until both possible rebounds are known.

fallback.title: Left drop-bank fallback
fallback.when: Use this plan after Double Bonus is lit and base bonus is near 15,000, or when the return-to-top lanes are unsafe.

steps.text: Cradle on the lower right flipper. Shoot one left drop target at a time.
Each target scores 500. A full bank scores 3,000 and resets the bank.
The first completion can light Extra Ball at the right inlane. The second lights Special at the left outlane.
Later completions award Special directly.
Stop when the bank rebound begins to threaten either outlane.

alternatives.title: Base-bonus-only route
alternatives.when: Use this plan when A or B will not fall safely.

steps.text: Continue lit outer top lanes and lit return-to-top stars.
Roll through lit outer top lanes and lit return-to-top stars until base bonus reaches 15,000.
Protect the 15,000 collect instead of forcing the missing A or B lane.
Roll through the lit center top lane to open the right gate.
Collect A and B for Double Bonus.
Roll through lit outer top lanes and lit return-to-top stars until base bonus reaches 15,000.
Drain without tilting to collect 30,000.
Repeat on the next ball. No progress carries between balls.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is the standard coin-operated machine, not the different 1977 home model.
Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted to points before extending the drop-bank route past its 3,000 completion value.

techniques.name: Upper-right hold
techniques.instruction: Hold the upper right flipper up as a ball descends beside it. A useful deflection sends the ball toward the lower left flippers. Test the feed first.

techniques.name: Lower-flipper return-to-top shots
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left lane from the lower right flipper. Shoot the right lane from the lower left flipper.

techniques.name: Lower-right drop-bank line
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left bank from the lower right flipper. Do not use an upper flipper unless the rebound is proven safe.

cautions.issue: An upper-flipper drop-bank shot can drain on either side.
cautions.response: Use the lower right flipper. A low miss can enter the left outlane, and a completed hit can rebound toward the right outlane.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits can drain directly or reach a slingshot at speed.
cautions.response: Keep both lower sides ready until the feed is clear.

cautions.issue: A score roll at 100,000 triggers a loud buzzer.
cautions.response: Expect the sound so it does not interrupt the next flip.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Send the ball to the top until the right gate is open, A and B are complete, and base bonus is 15,000.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Roll through the lit center top lane to open the right gate.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Left drop-bank fallback: Use this plan after Double Bonus is lit and base bonus is near 15,000, or when the return-to-top lanes are unsafe.

strategy.simpleOverview: Captain Fantastic sends the ball back to the top to collect lit lanes, A and B, and base-bonus advances. Keep returning upstairs until base bonus reaches 15,000, then protect the 30,000 Double Bonus collect. Use the left drop bank only when the top route becomes unsafe.
strategy.overview: Captain Fantastic builds base bonus through lit top lanes and doubles it after A and B are collected. Return the ball to the top until base bonus reaches 15,000, then protect the 30,000 end-of-ball collect. Continue the top route for controlled scoring, or shoot the left drop bank from the lower-right flipper when the upper feed becomes unsafe.
machineSetup: Confirm this is the standard coin-operated machine, not the different 1977 home model.
Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted to points before extending the drop-bank route past its 3,000 completion value.
